defs.def: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do 可选择的事物；选择；选择权；选择的自由

ex.s: Panda Gourmet offers online ordering for takeout, and delivery is now an option.
ex.t: Panda Gourmet提供外卖在线点餐，现在也支持配送。

ex.s: To reduce our impact, we can take simple steps: empty the fridge before heading out, and choose sustainable dining options.
ex.t: 为了减少我们的影响，我们可以采取简单的步骤：出门前清空冰箱，并选择可持续的就餐选择。

ex.s: It has a seemingly bottomless well of dining options.
ex.t: 它有一个似乎无底井 的餐具选择。

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

ex.s: In addition to saving money, cheese brine could also be a more eco-friendly option.
ex.t: 除了省钱外，奶酪浴缸还可以是一种更有利于生态的选择。

ex.s: Our café offers a complete menu of lunch and snack options, in addition to seasonal specials.
ex.t: 我们的咖啡馆提供完整的午餐和小吃菜单，此外还有季节特色菜。

ex.s: But if you don't have net connection when you travel, a paper map is still an option.
ex.t: 但如果你旅行时没有网络连接，纸质地图仍然是一个选择。

ex.s: Then we can weigh up the options and try to come to a decision.
ex.t: 然后我们可以权衡各种选择，尽量做出决定。

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

defs.def: a subject that a student can choose to study, but that they do not have to do 选修课
the right to buy or sell sth at some time in the future （未来的）买卖选择权

ex.s: Grandfather: If you go to university and play music at the same time, you will have two options for your future.
ex.t: 祖父：如果你上大学同时玩音乐，你对未来就有两个选择。

defs.def: one of the choices you can make when using a computer program 选项；选择

ex.s: For groups of 35 or more, please call to discuss options.
ex.t: 35人或以上的团体请致电讨论选项。

ex.s: One option is to explore other planets to see if we could live on them.
ex.t: 一个选择是探索其他行星，看看我们能否在上面居住。

ex.s: Register online or fill out a Group Play Registration Form with multiple date and start time options.
ex.t: 在线注册，或填写团体活动注册表，提供多个日期和开始时间选项。

ex.s: Tom watched his mum make healthy fruit infusions but then struggle for a take-along option.
ex.t: 汤姆看着妈妈制作健康的水果饮品，但随后在为随身带的选择上犯难。
